def is_safe_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is a plain, non-empty single path component: no separators, no NUL, and not "." or ".."."""
    ex is_safe_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_safe_name("") == False
    ex is_safe_name("..") == False
    ex is_safe_name("../secret") == False
    ex is_safe_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    ex is_safe_name("a\\b") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name or "\0" in name:
        return False
    return True

def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the first name in names that is a safe name and can be read from the directory notes, or "" when none can.
    Unsafe names are skipped, and a missing or unreadable file is skipped.
    The read happens inside with fs = fs.sub("notes"), so no name can reach outside notes."""
    post names.len() > 0 or out == ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        for name in names:
            if not is_safe_name(name):
                continue
            text = read_note(name)
            if text is not None:
                return text
    return ""

def read_note(name: str) -> str | None uses fs:
    """Text of the file name in the current fs, or None when it cannot be read."""
    text = fs.read_text(name) else return None
    return text
